verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਉਲੂ ਆਦਿਤ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਉ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise uloo aadhit udhot jot kau na jaane aan dhev sevakai na sujhai saadh sa(n)g mai ||

en.bdb: Just as an owl cannot know the greatness of sunlight, similarly a worshipper of other deities cannot have perception of True Guru's advice and company of the holy men.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਰਕਟ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਸਬਦ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: marakaT man maanik mahimaa na jaane aan dhev sevak na sabadh prasa(n)g mai ||

en.bdb: Just as a monkey does not know the value of pearls and diamonds, so can a follower of other deities not assess the importance of Guru's sermon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਫਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੈ ਪਾਨ ਮਹਾਤਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਗ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau fani(n)dhr pai paan mahaatamai na jaanai aan dhev sevak mahaa prasaadh a(n)g mai ||

en.bdb: Just as a cobra cannot appreciate nectar-like milk, similarly a follower of other gods cannot understand significance of the blessings of the Guru's word and his consecrated gift of Karhah Parsad.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਬਗ ਠਗ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਟਿਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਮੈ ॥੪੫੩॥
verses.translit_en: bin ha(n)s ba(n)s bag Thag na sakat Tik agam agaadh sukh saagar tara(n)g mai ||453||

en.bdb: Just as an egret cannot fit in a flock of swans, a worshipper of other gods cannot stay in the society of devout Sikhs blessed by the True Guru, nor can he understand the deep nuances of the waves of knowledge and teachings of the Guru. (453)
